name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2026-02-09, at wavelengths from 0.86 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
